exercises.oracleBody: all c:Class,s:Student | some s.(c.Groups)

exercises.title: classroom fol · inv11

exercises.title: classroom fol · inv12

exercises.oracleBody: all x:Teacher | some x.Teaches.Groups

exercises.title: classroom fol · inv13
exercises.description: Every tutoring link goes from a teacher to a student. No tutoring links are required to exist.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate

exercises.title: classroom fol · inv14

exercises.title: classroom fol · inv15

exercises.title: classroom rl · inv13

exercises.title: coursesNew · inv13

exercises.title: coursesNew · inv15
exercises.description: When two distinct people work on the same project in a course and both have grades in that course, every grade of either person must equal or be immediately adjacent to at least one grade of the other in the grade ordering. If either person has no grade in the course, this requirement imposes no comparison on that pair.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all x:Student, y:Student-x, p:Project, c:Course, g:Grade| x->p in projects and y->p in projects and c->x->g in grades implies #c->y->g <= 1
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Course, p : c.projects, disj x,y : (Person <: projects).p | some c.grades[x] and some c.grades[y] implies c.grades[x] in c.grades[y].(prev+iden+next)

exercises.title: cv v1 · inv1

exercises.title: cv v1 · inv2

exercises.title: cv v1 · inv3
exercises.description: Within any user's profile, two distinct works supplied by the same source must not share an identifier.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.oracleBody: all u : User, disj x,y : u.profile | x.source = y.source implies no (x.ids & y.ids)

exercises.title: cv v1 · inv4
exercises.description: No two distinct works that the same user makes visible may be connected by a chain of works in which consecutive works share an identifier. The chain may pass through any works, including works outside that user's profile.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate

exercises.oracleBody: all u : User, disj x,y : u.visible | x not in y.^((u.profile <: ids).~(u.profile <: ids))

exercises.title: graphs · inv1
exercises.description: Every directed edge must have an edge in the reverse direction as well. Self-loops are permitted.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: some Node.adj implies some adj.Node
exercises.oracleBody: adj = ~adj

exercises.title: graphs · inv2
exercises.description: No pair of nodes may have edges in both directions between them. Self-loops are also forbidden.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all n1: Node, n2: Node | (n1 -> n2) in adj implies (n2 -> n2) not in adj
exercises.oracleBody: no adj & ~adj

exercises.title: graphs · inv3
exercises.description: There must be no directed cycles: no node may reach itself by following one or more edges.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: not iden in ^adj
exercises.oracleBody: all n : Node | n not in n.^adj

exercises.title: graphs · inv4
exercises.description: There must be a directed edge from every node to every node, including an edge from each node to itself.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all n : Node | Node - n in n.adj
exercises.oracleBody: adj = Node -> Node

exercises.title: graphs · inv5
exercises.description: No node may have an edge to itself.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: iden not in ^adj
exercises.oracleBody: no adj & iden

exercises.title: graphs · inv6
exercises.description: Ignoring edge directions, every node must be reachable from every other node. A node is considered reachable from itself without taking an edge.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: not lone Node implies  Node in (Node.adj  + adj.Node)
exercises.oracleBody: all n:Node | Node = n.*(adj+~adj)

exercises.title: graphs · inv7
exercises.description: Following edge directions, every node must be reachable from every other node. A node is considered reachable from itself without taking an edge.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all n:Node | Node-n in (n.^adj + n.^~adj)
exercises.oracleBody: all n:Node | Node = n.*adj

exercises.title: graphs · inv8
exercises.description: Whenever one node can reach another by following one or more directed edges, there must also be a direct edge from the first node to the second. In particular, any node on a directed cycle must have a self-loop.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all disj a,b,c : Node | (a in adj.b and c in b.adj) => c in a.adj
exercises.oracleBody: adj = ^adj

exercises.title: lts · inv1
exercises.description: Every state must have at least one outgoing transition, labelled by some event and leading to some state.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: let s = State <: trans.Event | s.~s in iden
exercises.oracleBody: all s:State | some s.trans

exercises.title: lts · inv2
exercises.description: There must be exactly one initial state.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: some Init
exercises.oracleBody: one Init

exercises.title: lts · inv3
exercises.description: For any state and event, there may be at most one destination state for a transition with that event. An event need not be enabled at every state.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all s:State, s1:State, e:Event | lone e->s1
exercises.oracleBody: all s : State, e : Event | lone e.(s.trans)

exercises.title: lts · inv4
exercises.description: Every state must be reachable from at least one initial state by following one or more transitions. This includes initial states themselves; a zero-transition path does not count.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: State.(Event.trans) in Init.*(Event.trans)
exercises.oracleBody: let ts = {s1,s2:State | some e:Event | s1->e->s2 in trans} | all s:State | some i:Init | s in i.^ts

exercises.title: lts · inv5
exercises.description: All states must enable exactly the same set of events. Their transition destinations may differ, and the shared set of enabled events may be empty.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all s : State | s.trans in State.trans
exercises.oracleBody: all s1,s2:State | s1.trans.State = s2.trans.State

exercises.title: lts · inv6
exercises.description: Every event must label at least one transition somewhere in the system.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all e: Event | some e->State
exercises.oracleBody: State.trans.State = Event

exercises.title: lts · inv7
exercises.description: Every state reachable from an initial state by one or more transitions must be able to reach some initial state by one or more transitions. The return destination need not be the initial state where the first path began.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: let trans_bin = {s1, s2 : State | some s1.trans.s2} | Init in Init.*trans_bin.*trans_bin
exercises.oracleBody: let ts = {s1,s2:State | some e:Event | s1->e->s2 in trans} | all s:Init.^ts | some i:Init | i in s.^ts

exercises.title: productionLineNew · inv1
exercises.description: Every worker must be either a human or a robot.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all w:Worker| no Human&Robot
exercises.oracleBody: Worker = Human + Robot

exercises.title: productionLineNew · inv2
exercises.description: Every workstation must have at least one worker, and every worker must be assigned to exactly one workstation.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter:
all w : Worker | one w & Workstation.workers
all ws: Workstation | some ws.workers
exercises.oracleBody: workers in Workstation one -> some Worker

exercises.title: productionLineNew · inv3
exercises.description: Every component must be assigned to exactly one workstation.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all m:Material | m in Component  => one workstation.m
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component | one c.workstation

exercises.title: productionLineNew · inv4
exercises.description: Every component must have at least one direct part, and materials must have no parts.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all p : Product | (some p.parts and p in Product) or p in Material
exercises.oracleBody:
all c : Component | some c.parts
	all m : Material | no m.parts

exercises.title: productionLineNew · inv5
exercises.description: A workstation must not have both human workers and robot workers assigned to it. A workstation with no workers satisfies this requirement.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all w: Workstation |all tr: Worker| (tr not in (w.workers & Robot)) or (tr not in (w.workers & Human))
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Workstation | no (c.workers & Human) or no (c.workers & Robot)

exercises.title: productionLineNew · inv6
exercises.description: No component may contain itself as a part, either directly or through a chain of one or more part relationships.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c : Component | c not in c.parts
exercises.oracleBody: no c : Component | c in c.^parts

exercises.title: productionLineNew · inv7
exercises.description: A component with at least one dangerous direct part must itself be marked dangerous.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c:Component | some p:Product | (p in Dangerous && p in c.parts) => c in Component
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component | some c.parts & Dangerous implies c in Dangerous

exercises.title: productionLineNew · inv8
exercises.description: No human may work at any workstation assigned to a dangerous component.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c: Component| all h: Human| all w: Workstation| (c.parts in Dangerous and w in workstation.c) implies h not in w.workers
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component & Dangerous | no c.workstation.workers & Human

exercises.title: productionLineNew · inv9
exercises.description: Every workstation except end must have exactly one immediate successor, and end must have none. Starting at begin and taking zero or more successor steps must reach every workstation.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter:
all ws : (Workstation-end) | one ws.succ
no end.succ
no succ.begin
exercises.oracleBody:
all w : Workstation - end | one w.succ
	no end.succ
	Workstation in begin.*succ

exercises.title: productionLineNew · inv10
exercises.description: For every component, each workstation assigned to any of its direct parts that are themselves components must be able to reach a workstation assigned to the containing component by one or more successor steps. Parts with no assigned workstation impose no ordering requirement.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c : Component , ws:Workstation | c.parts in ws implies c.parts in c
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component, p : c.parts | p.workstation in ^succ.(c.workstation)

exercises.title: productionLine v1 · inv1
exercises.description: Every component must have at least one direct part.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component | some c.parts

exercises.title: productionLine v1 · inv2
exercises.description: No component may contain itself as a part, either directly or through a chain of one or more part relationships.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: iden not in (^parts).~(^parts)
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component | c not in c.^parts

exercises.title: productionLine v1 · inv3
exercises.description: Each component must have at least one robot at its position.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c:Component | some (c.position)
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component | some position.(c.position) & Robot

exercises.title: productionLine v1 · inv4
exercises.description: Every direct part that is itself a component must be positioned at or before the component that contains it in the ordering of positions. The two components may occupy the same position.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c:Component | c.position not in c.position.^next
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component, p : c.parts & Component | lte[p.position,c.position]

exercises.title: productionLine v2 · inv1
exercises.description: Every worker must be either a human or a robot.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: no Human & Robot
exercises.oracleBody: Worker = Human + Robot

exercises.title: productionLine v2 · inv2
exercises.description: Every workstation must have at least one worker, and every worker must be assigned to exactly one workstation.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter:
all w: Workstation | some w.workers
all w: Worker | one w&Workstation.workers
exercises.oracleBody: workers in Workstation one -> some Worker

exercises.title: productionLine v2 · inv3
exercises.description: Every component must be assigned to exactly one workstation.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c : Component | one wb : Workstation | c.workstation in wb
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component | one c.workstation

exercises.title: productionLine v2 · inv4
exercises.description: Every component must have at least one direct part, and materials must have no parts.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c : Component, m : Material | (some c.parts) and (no m.parts)
exercises.oracleBody:
all c : Component | some c.parts
	all m : Material | no m.parts

exercises.title: productionLine v2 · inv5
exercises.description: A workstation must not have both human workers and robot workers assigned to it. A workstation with no workers satisfies this requirement.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter:
all w : Workstation | w.workers not in Human implies w.workers  in Robot
and w.workers not in Robot implies w.workers  in Human
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Workstation | no (c.workers & Human) or no (c.workers & Robot)

exercises.title: productionLine v2 · inv6
exercises.description: No component may contain itself as a part, either directly or through a chain of one or more part relationships.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c:Component | c not in c.parts
exercises.oracleBody: no c : Component | c in c.^parts

exercises.title: productionLine v2 · inv7
exercises.description: A component with at least one dangerous direct part must itself be marked dangerous.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c:Component | c.*parts in Dangerous => c in Dangerous
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component | some c.parts & Dangerous implies c in Dangerous

exercises.title: productionLine v2 · inv8
exercises.description: No human may work at any workstation assigned to a dangerous component.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c: Component, w: Workstation, h: Human | c in Dangerous and w in c.workstation implies Human not in w.workers
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component & Dangerous | no c.workstation.workers & Human

exercises.title: productionLine v2 · inv9
exercises.description: Every workstation except end must have exactly one immediate successor, and end must have none. Starting at begin and taking zero or more successor steps must reach every workstation.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all w :Workstation | w not in end implies one w.succ
exercises.oracleBody:
all w : Workstation - end | one w.succ
	no end.succ
	Workstation in begin.*succ

exercises.title: productionLine v2 · inv10
exercises.description: For every component, each workstation assigned to any of its direct parts that are themselves components must be able to reach a workstation assigned to the containing component by one or more successor steps. Parts with no assigned workstation impose no ordering requirement.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all c: Component | all p: c.parts | p in c.*(parts-prev)
exercises.oracleBody: all c : Component, p : c.parts | p.workstation in ^succ.(c.workstation)

exercises.title: socialMedia · inv1
exercises.description: Every photo must be posted by exactly one user.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all x:Photo | some y:User | y -> x in posts
exercises.oracleBody: all p : Photo | one posts.p

exercises.title: socialMedia · inv2
exercises.description: No user may follow themselves.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all x, y : User | x.follows = y implies x !=y
exercises.oracleBody: all p : User | p not in p.follows

exercises.title: socialMedia · inv3
exercises.description: Every non-advertisement photo a user sees must have been posted by someone that user follows. Advertisements are unrestricted by this requirement.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all u : User | all p : sees.u - Ad | posts.p in follows.u
exercises.oracleBody: all p : User | p.sees - Ad in p.follows.posts

exercises.title: socialMedia · inv4
exercises.description: Any user who posts at least one advertisement must post only advertisements.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: (posts & User->Ad) = (posts :> Ad)
exercises.oracleBody: all u : posts.Ad | u.posts in Ad

exercises.title: socialMedia · inv5
exercises.description: Every influencer must be followed by all other users and must not follow themselves.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all i : Influencer | all u : User-i | u in follows.i
exercises.oracleBody: all i : Influencer | follows.i = User - i

exercises.title: socialMedia · inv6
exercises.description: Every influencer must post at least one photo dated on each day in the model.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all i : Influencer, d : Day | some i.posts.date & Day
exercises.oracleBody: all i : Influencer, d : Day | some i.posts & date.d

exercises.title: socialMedia · inv7
exercises.description: A user's suggested users must be exactly the users followed by someone that user follows, excluding the user themselves and anyone they already follow.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter:
all u1, u2 : User | (u2 not in Influencer and u2 not in u1.follows and u2 in u1.^follows and u1 != u2) implies u2 in u1.suggested
all u1 : User | u1 not in u1.suggested
exercises.oracleBody: all u : User | u.suggested = u.follows.follows - u.follows - u

exercises.title: socialMedia · inv8
exercises.description: Every advertisement a user sees must have been posted by someone they follow or someone suggested to them.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all u : User | all ad : u.sees - Photo | all f : u.follows | all s : u.suggested | ad not in u.posts and ad in f.posts or ad in s.posts
exercises.oracleBody: all u : User, p : u.sees & Ad | p in u.(follows+suggested).posts

exercises.title: trainStationNew · inv1
exercises.description: The station must have at least one entry track and at least one exit track.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: some Entry
exercises.oracleBody:
some Entry
	some Exit

exercises.title: trainStationNew · inv2
exercises.description: Every signal must be assigned to exactly one track.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all s : Signal | s in Track.signals or s in Track.^succs.signals
exercises.oracleBody: all s : Signal | one signals.s

exercises.title: trainStationNew · inv3
exercises.description: The exit tracks must be exactly those tracks with no immediate successor.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all t:Track | some e:Track | all ts:Track | t->e in succs and t!=ts and e->ts not in succs implies e in Exit
exercises.oracleBody: all t : Track | t in Exit iff no t.succs

exercises.title: trainStationNew · inv4
exercises.description: The entry tracks must be exactly those tracks with no immediate predecessor.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: no succs.Entry
exercises.oracleBody: all t : Track | t in Entry iff no succs.t

exercises.title: trainStationNew · inv5
exercises.description: A track must be a junction exactly when it has at least two immediate predecessors.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all t: Track | t in Junction implies #succs.t > 1
exercises.oracleBody: all t : Track | t not in Junction iff lone succs.t

exercises.title: trainStationNew · inv6
exercises.description: Every entry track must have at least one speed signal.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all t : Track & Entry | some t.signals
exercises.oracleBody: all t : Entry | some t.signals & Speed

exercises.title: trainStationNew · inv7
exercises.description: The successor connections must contain no directed cycles, including self-loops.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all t:Track | t not in t.succs and t not in t.~(Track<:succs)
exercises.oracleBody: no t : Track | t in t.^succs

exercises.title: trainStationNew · inv8
exercises.description: Every exit track must be reachable from every entry track by following zero or more successor connections.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all t: Track| some t&Entry implies (Exit in t.^succs or some t&Exit)
exercises.oracleBody: all e : Entry, x : Exit | x in e.*succs

exercises.title: trainStationNew · inv9
exercises.description: A track may have a semaphore signal only if at least one of its immediate successors is a junction.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all t: Track | no (t.^succs & Junction) => no (t.signals & Semaphore)
exercises.oracleBody: all t : Track | no t.succs & Junction implies no t.signals & Semaphore

exercises.title: trainStationNew · inv10
exercises.description: Every track that leads directly into a junction must have at least one semaphore signal.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all j : Junction, t : succs.j | some t.signals
exercises.oracleBody: all j : Junction, t : succs.j | some t.signals & Semaphore

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv1
exercises.description: Initially, no signal may be green.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all t:Track | Green not in t.signal until Green in t.signal
exercises.oracleBody: no Green

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv2
exercises.description: Every signal must be green at least once, either initially or at a later state.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: eventually Green in Signal
exercises.oracleBody: all s : Signal | eventually s in Green

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv3
exercises.description: Each train must keep its initial position forever. A train initially outside the station must remain outside forever.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: always prox = prox'
exercises.oracleBody: always pos' = pos

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv4
exercises.description: At every state, each track may be occupied by at most one train.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all tk : Track | lone pos.tk :> Train
exercises.oracleBody: always all t : Track | lone pos.t

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv5
exercises.description: At every step, a train already in the station may stay on its current track; otherwise, it must leave the station if on an exit track, or move to an immediate successor if on any other track. This requirement places no restriction on a train that is currently outside the station.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: always all t: Train | t.prox not in Exit implies t.pos' in t.pos + t.pos.prox
exercises.oracleBody: all t : Train | always (some t.pos implies (t.pos' = t.pos or (t.pos in Exit implies no t.pos' else (some t.pos' and t.pos' in t.pos.prox))))

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv6
exercises.description: Every signal must be green infinitely often and non-green infinitely often.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter:
always (all s:Signal | always (s in Green) implies eventually (s not in Green ) or
always s not in Green implies  eventually (s in  Green) )
exercises.oracleBody: all s : Signal | always eventually (s in Green) and always eventually (s not in Green)

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv7
exercises.description: Whenever a train is in the station, it must eventually be outside the station again.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all t : Train | eventually no t.pos
exercises.oracleBody: all t : Train | always (some t.pos implies eventually no t.pos)

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv8
exercises.description: Whenever a train occupies a track with a non-green signal, it must stay on that track through the first state in which the signal becomes green. If the signal never becomes green, the train must stay there forever.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: always ( all tk:Track | some tk.signal and (tk.signal in Green) implies ( #pos.tk' = #pos.tk ) )
exercises.oracleBody: all t : Train, p : Track | always (t.pos = p and p.signal not in Green implies (p.signal in Green releases t.pos = p))

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv9
exercises.description: Every train must eventually occupy an entry track and must be outside the station in every preceding state. Occupying an entry track in the initial state is allowed.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: ( all t:Train |no t.pos implies  eventually ( some t.pos and t.pos in Entry) )
exercises.oracleBody: all t : Train | no t.pos until (some t.pos & Entry)

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv10
exercises.description: At every state, at most one signal on the tracks leading directly into any given junction may be green.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: all j:Junction | lone ( (prox.j).signal & Green )
exercises.oracleBody: all j : Junction | always lone (prox.j).signal & Green

exercises.title: trainStationOld · inv11
exercises.description: Whenever a train is in the station, it must have occupied an entry track in the current state or in an earlier state.
exercises.descriptionProvenance: Reviewed natural-language interpretation of the source-bound corpus predicate
exercises.starter: always (all t:Train | some t.pos implies once t.pos in Entry)
